Voice of Vietnam FAQ

What frequency is Voice of Vietnam on?
In the B-26 season Voice of Vietnam is scheduled on 7 shortwave frequencies, including 7220, 7221, 7285, 9835, 9840, 11885 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9840 kHz (5 am – 5:30 am Eastern). For Europe: 9835 kHz (8 pm – 8:30 pm UTC+1).

What time is Voice of Vietnam on shortwave?
Voice of Vietnam is scheduled in 27 UTC time windows this season, from 10:00–10:30 UTC through 23:30–24h UTC. English broadcasts: 16:00–16:30 UTC; 20:30–21:00 UTC; 19:00–19:30 UTC; 21:30–22:00 UTC. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear Voice of Vietnam in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9840 kHz (5 am – 5:30 am Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Voice of Vietnam broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 7220 kHz at 16:00–16:30 UTC to Middle East; 7220 kHz at 20:30–21:00 UTC to Middle East; 9835 kHz at 16:00–16:30 UTC to Europe; 9835 kHz at 19:00–19:30 UTC to Europe; 9835 kHz at 21:30–22:00 UTC to Europe; plus 11 more.

Is Voice of Vietnam on the air right now?
As of Saturday, November 7, 2026, 11:43 UTC, Voice of Vietnam is scheduled to be broadcasting on 7285 kHz to SE Asia. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
